risk.observed: Audio track reports muted=true and contains audio clips.
risk.why: This can be intentional. It is a delivery risk only if audio from this track is expected.
risk.remediation: Confirm whether the mute is intentional. Do not auto-unmute.

risk.observed: Audio clip track item reports disabled=true.
risk.why: A disabled clip will not contribute expected timeline audio, but disabling may be intentional.
risk.remediation: Confirm whether the clip disable state is intentional. Do not auto-enable.
